review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR set, CS_CAPABILITIES includes retail), plus a second production pass recorded in armor-vocabulary.json. MEASURED: ASSETS/SCRIPTS/ARMOR.SCRIPT in GOSDATA/ASSETS/crimson.rof builds four armor titles (ar_t_nosetitle, ar_t_tailtitle, ar_t_lefttitle, ar_t_righttitle, in that order), declares object X[4] and builds four ar_d_point dropdowns asking the engine through callback 2247, and asks for the armor name and description through callbacks 2220 and 2225; ASSETS/LAYOUT.CSV places each title (IDS_AR_*_TITLE) and each dropdown below its own title and above the next, and declares PUR_T_ARMORLIST, PUR_T_ARMORWEIGHT and PUR_T_ARMORCOST in [@Purchase@]; RESOURCE.H declares IDS_PX_ARMORUNITS. All read through cs_content::damage::read_original_armor_vocabulary with observed_tool provenance naming the member's stored extent and the decoded line. NOT CLAIMED: this is an armor vocabulary. No shipped file maps a gun group onto a position, so f27.d.limit.gun_group_assignment stays deferred, DeclaredGunMountKind gains no side, and OriginalArmorVocabulary::gun_group_for answers Resolved::Unknown. No armor amount, zone or damage rule is recorded (F29 owns that model). Nothing is verified_original and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval.
